description: This file defines the MaintenanceDao class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, which extends a base DAO class and provides a method to extract data based on employee number and table name. It interacts with a database using Doctrine QueryBuilder.

classes.name: MaintenanceDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for maintenance-related database operations, extending from BaseDao, and containing methods to query employee data.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves data from a specified table based on employee number and optional join criteria, constructing a Doctrine query dynamically.
